verdicts.reason: I'd pick A by a small margin; both have broken badge rows. A: its headline is the largest and reads clearly, but the logo is pushed top-left while everything else is centred. The three badges are broken into a lone 'Limited Edition' on the left with two badges below it on a different grid, the body copy is jammed under the headline, and the bottom is dead space plus a broken image placeholder. B: the logo is centred, but the headline runs almost to the canvas edges with very thin side margins. The badges step down diagonally, leaving 'Small Batch' stranded alone on the right, and the body and legal text are small. B also has the same placeholder box.
